findings.title: Late pre-midnight refresh can overwrite a fresh next-day self read
trigger: The selected self history interval already includes the next rule-timezone day.
A refresh loads a complete history snapshot before midnight while another refresh task remains pending.
The midnight watcher obtains a fresh next-day self row and renders clocked-in.
The older refresh finishes and its finally block reuses the pre-midnight history snapshot.
findings.observed_result: A confirmed next-day clocked-in state becomes not-clocked-in without a further self read.
findings.expected_result: Pre-midnight history must not supersede the newer next-day self response.
findings.root_cause: The final refresh read defaults to reuseHistory=true. History scope proves date/user/org/completeness but carries no observation date; a new load version cannot detect old data reused by a newer invocation.
findings.minimal_fix_direction: Stamp query/refresh start instants and prevent pre-midnight history reuse at both refreshAll finally and loadRecords direct today-read calls when the resolved rule-date has advanced.
findings.candidate_fix_scope: Four lines across two functions in isolated temporary source only; shared implementation unchanged.
findings.candidate_fix: Capture refreshStartedAt = heroClockNow.value; pass formatAttendanceDateKey(refreshStartedAt, resolvedAttendanceTimezone.value) === todayWorkDateKey.value to loadTodayAttendanceRecord.
findings.reproduction_test: ASTRA: late refresh completion cannot replace a fresh midnight read with pre-midnight history
findings.discarded_candidate: Capturing only the initially empty today key forced an unnecessary first-load query and broke two existing midnight tests; that candidate was discarded.

additional_entry_path.reproduction_test: ASTRA: focused approval history response cannot replace a fresh midnight self read
trigger: Open a focused pending approval in Overview with a self history date range including the next rule day.
Click Approve and allow its successful POST, request reload and summary reload to complete.
Hold the resulting pre-midnight history response while the midnight independent self read returns next-day clocked-in.
Release the older history response: loadRecords calls loadTodayAttendanceRecord with history reuse enabled and overwrites the next-day state.
additional_entry_path.reachability: DOM button path through the existing approval-center focused request fixture; no direct invocation of private component functions.
additional_entry_path.insufficient_fix: The refreshAll-only candidate remains red for this path.
additional_entry_path.additional_minimal_fix: Capture recordsLoadStartedAt = heroClockNow.value at loadRecords entry; its direct loadTodayAttendanceRecord call may reuse history only when formatAttendanceDateKey(recordsLoadStartedAt, resolvedAttendanceTimezone.value) === todayWorkDateKey.value.
additional_entry_path.other_suggested_entry_points: Records Reload and pagination UI are guarded by showReports, so those UI entry points themselves do not directly enter the overview-only today update; focused approval is sufficient confirmed reachability.
additional_entry_path.warning: The green run logged a development WebSocket port collision; mocked DOM tests completed normally with exit 0.

reviewed_without_additional_findings: Legacy punch guard evaluates the final append-or-merge projection after event and projection writes, before returning to the canonical transaction wrapper.
Canonical transaction wrapper rolls back adapter exceptions; legacy-compatible and shadow paths use the adapter, authoritative live path uses its distinct insert/core path.

Historical request prefill preserves unchanged absolute instants including seconds and milliseconds, parses edited wall time in the historical zone, rejects DST gaps by roundtrip, and documents earlier-overlap choice.
Prefill binds loaded history organization/user, record user and raw event user, clears history state before consumption, and drops raw responses after history scope replacement.

Dedicated today read carries immutable session organization and omits editable target user; unknown/error display and existing late-dedicated-response invalidation are covered by source and supplied tests.

checks: loadRecords captures an immutable Date reference before initiating its history request and checks that instant in the final resolved rule timezone before reusing history for today.
refreshAll independently captures its start instant and applies the same condition in finally, covering the long-running parallel task path.
heroClockNow is replaced with a new Date each timer tick; the captured references retain the start instant across midnight.
First-load rule timezone may initially be unavailable. Both guards defer date formatting until the final rule timezone is available, preserving same-day initial history reuse.
Missing or invalid final timezone does not become a valid today key; loadTodayAttendanceRecord retains the unknown-state early return.
Two named DOM regressions exercise actual Refresh and focused-approval button paths, assert the fresh clocked-in intermediate state, release the older response, then assert it survives.
The final guards match the semantics independently validated in the temporary four-test green run recorded above.
